description.value: Pre-Cinder records are half-burned and half-lied about, but you know which half to trust. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Decipher Writing or Recall Knowledge checks made using surviving pre-Turning records and archives.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 is conditioned on the source material used ('surviving pre-Turning records and archives'), not a target creature's trait -- there is no roll option for what reference material a check is made with.
